title: Stack
description: Flex layout primitives (Stack, HStack, VStack) with token-based gaps, optional separators and attached groups. Children are not wrapped in item elements.

wc:minerva-stack.summary: Flex row / column layout with gap, alignment, separators and attached groups.
wc:minerva-stack.description: A flex container laying out its children in a row or column with a token-based gap (`<Stack>` of React). Children are not wrapped; a `separator` is inserted between them, and `attached` joins them into one group (shared borders, outer corners only, `role="group"`). Shadow DOM notes: the children stay in the light DOM and are slotted into the React library's `.stack` flex container. Separators are interleaved with manual slot assignment (one slot per child). Where `HTMLSlotElement.assign()` is missing (Safari < 16.4 and other older engines) the stack falls back to named slots: each element child gets a `slot="minerva-stack-item-<n>"` attribute (only while a separator is set; removed again afterwards), so separators render between element children in both modes. Bare text children cannot carry a `slot` attribute: in the fallback they render after the element children without separators (wrap them in an element, e.g. a `<span>`). The `attached` rules style the children through `::slotted()` (top-level children only); their radius rules reach elements whose own box has the radius (native buttons / inputs), not the inner control of a custom element.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Gap between items: numbers select spacing tokens (`2` -> `var(--space-2)`), other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted

properties.name: separator
properties.description: Rendered between every two items: a text (attribute) or a function returning fresh content (e.g. a new `<minerva-divider orientation="vertical">`) per gap

properties.name: attached
properties.description: Joins the items into one attached group: no gap, shared borders and outer-only corner radii, `role="group"` (name it with `aria-label`)

cssProperties.name: --stack-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the children when the gap prop is not set (default: 0)

wc:minerva-hstack.description: A horizontal stack (`<HStack>` of React): `direction` is always `row` and items are centered on the cross axis unless `align` is set.

<minerva-vstack
  attached
  aria-label="Account fields"
  style="margin-top: 16px; max-width: 280px"
>
  <input
    aria-label="Email"
    placeholder="Email"
    style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color)"
  />
  <input
    aria-label="Password"
    type="password"
    placeholder="Password"
    style="padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color)"
  />
</minerva-vstack>

examples.title: Separators and wrapping
examples.description: separator inserts a text between items, or, set as a JS property, a function returning fresh content per gap (here a vertical divider). wrap lets the items flow onto several lines. Separators use manual slot assignment; in browsers without slot.assign() (Safari < 16.4) the stack falls back to named slots (a slot="minerva-stack-item-n" attribute on each element child while a separator is set), so separators still appear between element children (wrap bare text in an element).
